mixed_driver_sum.meaning: All ten heterogeneous driver paths sum correctly, using the supplied/model phase and voltage-scaled source measurement levels.

common_voltage_check.requirement: Absolute multi-driver comparison at one input voltage must account for each baseline measurement voltage.
common_voltage_check.reproduction: Only drive_voltage_v changes from 0.1 to 0.2 V while the same numerical FR is retained.
common_voltage_check.limitation: Voltage scaling assumes linear response; this does not calibrate the source, coupler or missing measured phase.
